analysis_source: Locally decoded paired CSVs; F: became unavailable after decode. Source BIN hash unavailable.

decoder.sequence_direction_limit: modulo half-range; gaps >=32768 frames are ambiguous
decoder.timestamp_alignment: forward sequence steps; backwards/duplicate advances one row and is flagged

method: Stable bouts trim 1s each end; duration weighted Welch 4096, linear detrend; 50 +/-1 Hz, harmonics every 50 Hz from 100-450 +/-1 Hz. Transfer uses EMG008 only, five seeds, same 100ms/25ms MAV/WL/Energy/ZC/SSC and scaler+MLP(64,32).
